segments.name: Oncology
segments.description: Global oncology company delivering Tumor Treating Fields therapy through medical devices for cancer treatment.
segments.evidence: We are a global oncology company with a proprietary platform technology called Tumor Treating Fields ("TTFields"), which are electric fields that exert physical forces to kill cancer cells.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare providers and payers reimburse the company for Tumor Treating Fields therapy devices, with coverage policies established with public and private payers.
revenueModel.evidence: We have established coverage policies with both public and private payers for the use of Optune Gio in our active markets.

changes.text: In December 2025, the company submitted a PMA for Optune Mya for brain metastases from NSCLC, a new indication not previously marketed.
changes.evidence: In December 2025 we submitted the final module of the PMA, seeking approval under the proposed brand name Optune Mya ®.
